name: APMS Suicide History Items
original_measure: Adult Psychiatric Morbidity Survey suicide-history items
construct: Lifetime suicidal thoughts and lifetime suicide attempt history
response_model: 2 binary lifetime-history items; Yes/No; retain as separate indicators, no combined risk score
rights: NHS England states the APMS publication may be reused free of charge under the Open Government Licence v3.0, excluding logos.
safety: These are lifetime-history indicators, not a current-risk determination. Any positive history should be preserved as contextual information; current ideation, intent, plan, or recent behavior requires direct human assessment under the study's approved safety protocol.

items.text: Have you ever thought of taking your life, even if you would not really do it?
Have you ever made an attempt to take your life, by taking an overdose of tablets or in some other way?
